# Etapa A01 — Ingesta ENEMDU `r render_stage_assurance(report_context$stage_A01, audit_href = "../../audit/reporting/reporte_controles_internos.html#etapa-A01-controles-integridad")` {#etapa-A01 .rap-assurance-heading}


```{r}
#| label: stage-A01-context

stage_A01 <- report_context$stage_A01
```

## Características generales de la base importada {#etapa-A01-resumen-base}

```{r}
#| label: stage-A01-database-overview

database_overview_report <- stage_A01$database_overview

integer_indicators <- c(
  "Observaciones",
  "Variables",
  "Variables con etiqueta",
  "Variables con etiquetas de valor"
)

database_overview_report$Valor[
  database_overview_report$Indicador %in% integer_indicators
] <- format_integer_es(
  database_overview_report$Valor[
    database_overview_report$Indicador %in% integer_indicators
  ]
)

database_overview_report$Valor[
  database_overview_report$Indicador == "Tamaño (MB)"
] <- format_decimal_es(
  database_overview_report$Valor[
    database_overview_report$Indicador == "Tamaño (MB)"
  ],
  digits = 2
)

database_overview_report |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = Indicador
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = Valor
  )
```


## Estructura de las variables requeridas para el procesamiento {#etapa-A01-variables-requeridas}

```{r}
#| label: stage-A01-required-variables

required_variables_report <- prepare_gt_view(
  stage_A01$required_variables_overview,
  integer_columns = c("Valid_N", "Missing_N", "Valid_Expanded", "Missing_Expanded")
)

required_variables_report |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Variable = "Variable",
    Class = "Clase",
    Valid_N = unname(reporting_labels[["valid_sample"]]),
    Missing_N = unname(reporting_labels[["missing_sample"]]),
    Valid_Expanded = unname(reporting_labels[["valid_population"]]),
    Missing_Expanded = unname(reporting_labels[["missing_population"]]),
    Label = "Etiqueta"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(
      Variable,
      Class,
      Label
    )
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      Valid_N,
      Missing_N,
      Valid_Expanded,
      Missing_Expanded
    )
  )
```
